summary: Recent M.S. Computer Engineering graduate from Rochester Institute of Technology (RIT), NY, building real-time machine vision and Edge AI systems on Jetson-class ARM Linux platforms in C++ and Python. Deployed a TensorRT-optimized YOLO inference pipeline (5.2× speedup, 92 FPS) as a systemd service on a headless Jetson, and built a metal-surface inspection pipeline at BARC. Hands-on with multi-camera image acquisition, sensor integration and hardware debugging, and led a 25-member robotics team.

experience.title: Research Intern (Capstone)
bullets: Architected a full machine vision metal-surface inspection pipeline for microscopic crack analysis using custom image stitching, wavelet denoising, and depth estimation.
Developed a custom image-stitching pipeline with bit manipulation and averaging, achieving a PSNR of 65 vs. a homography-stitching baseline (sym6+bior3.5 wavelet bank lifted it to 86).
Deployed ZoeDepth monocular depth estimation for crack-depth profiling with ±8% error on 3D surface reconstruction.

experience.title: Python Developer Intern
bullets: Developed a Python GUI using PyQt and Matplotlib for real-time data acquisition and experimental visualization in a laboratory environment.
Used GitLab for version control and JupyterHub for collaborative data analysis and technical documentation.

experience.title: General Secretary
bullets: Led a 25-member robotics team across national-level competitions, owning mechanical design, PCB fabrication, and AI/ML integration end-to-end.

projects.name: Voice-Controlled Robotic Arm (COFFIN) — MS Capstone, RIT
bullets: Integrated faster-whisper STT (1.0–1.4s), Gemini intent classification (<500ms), TensorRT-optimized YOLO (5.2× speedup: 56.7→10.9 ms, 17.6→92 FPS vs eager PyTorch) for visual servoing, and dual VL53L0X ToF sensors (camera range-gate + gripper-ToF-triggered close at 25 mm) for contact-aware grasping via TCA9548A I2C mux.

Deployed the Jetson-side arm bridge as a systemd service (Type=simple, auto-restart with backoff, non-root user/group isolation, environment-file-based config) with static IP networking for reliable multi-device WebSocket registration; configured XRDP for remote desktop administration of the headless Jetson.
Resolved 11 integration failures (false-positive detections, servo brown-out, stale-frame capture); achieved 100% pick reliability (10/10 trials) at ~11.5s end-to-end voice-to-picked latency.

projects.name: Object Tracking Turret
bullets: Used YOLOv8 on NVIDIA Jetson to detect and track objects, sending control commands to STM32 over UART.
Implemented multi-servo PWM control with interrupt-driven UART commands and user override.
